title: Unpermitted rooftop addition to low-rise condominium (Council Order 0015488)
jurisdiction: Alberta; municipality not identified in the order

facts.text: The decision describes a 3.5-storey low-rise condominium addition measuring about 4.88 m by 5.49 m, built on the roof without the required permits.
The owner’s engineer said the structure was stable and reported no sagging/drifting; the condominium corporation’s engineer reported structural-integrity concerns and imminent danger.
The owner’s engineer acknowledged reviewing drawings and reports but not seeing the exposed structure; the addition had been demolished by the hearing.
